response.overview: Mendee and Olzy are a middle-aged couple in Ulaanbaatar. Their son Bataa was a dashing, handsome young man, his whole life ahead of him, until he suffered a devastating car accident. Now Bataa is confined to a wheelchair, unable to talk, with brain damage that rather resembles cerebral palsy. Mendee is wheeling Bataa around the apartment building one day when her son, who is usually remote when he isn't suicidal depressed, fixes his attention on a gorgeous woman as she strolls past. Mendee, determined to help her son, tracks the woman to a nightclub. It turns out the woman, Naran, is a prostitute. Mendee approaches her with an unusual job offer: be Bataa's nurse and paid companion for a year.
response.title: Make Me A Man
